items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And Ed Jones used to lead the band with a baritone horn.

ctx.x: And they had a Eureka band, too. Yes. I didn't know it.
And Ed Jones used to lead the band with a baritone horn. One of them upright things, you know. Yes. And I was just over there. He did the flake jazz.
